content: Letter 32, to Amīr Sayyid Kārkiyā, either Sayyid Nāṣir or Sayyid Aḥmad (ca. 831-32/1428-29, Gilan): a brief congratulation on a conquest, crediting it to the presence of Sufis in the amir's retinue (TMN/M f. 51b, TMN/MS p. 26, TMN/D pp. 201-2). MK's footnote: their father Sayyid Riżā Kārkiyā died in 829/1426, before Ibn Turka's stay in Gilan.
